# Checkout API

**Container** · Node.js · inside [Shop](shop.md)

Validates carts, reserves stock and takes payment.

Its relationships are listed on its components, so container views show them as arrows from the Checkout API.

## Contains

- [Checkout Controller](checkout-controller.md) (component) – Handles checkout requests from the web app.
- [Order Repository](order-repository.md) (component) – Reads and writes orders.
- [Payment Client](payment-client.md) (component) – Wraps the payment provider's API.

## Libraries

- [Logging](logging.md) – Structured logs, written the same way in every part of the shop.
